sentences.sentence: Religion had an intimate association with alchemy during the Middle Ages.
sentences.translation: 在中世纪， 宗教和炼金术密切相联。

sentences.sentence: How could the ultimate scientist have been seemingly hornswoggled by a totemic psuedoscience like alchemy, which in its commonest rendering is described as the desire to transform lead into gold?

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 202 单元

decorum
音标：英 /dɪ'kɔːrəm/  美 /dɪ'kɔrəm/
n. 礼貌
例句：He was disciplined for breaching the Senate’s rules of decorum.
他因违反参议院的行为准则而受到处罚。

civility
音标：英 /sɪ'vɪlɪtɪ/  美 /sə'vɪləti/
n. 礼貌, 端庄
例句：Please have the civility to knock before you enter next time.
下次你进来之前要有点礼貌——先敲门。

apprehension
音标：英 /æprɪ'henʃ(ə)n/  美 /,æprɪ'hɛnʃən/
n. 理解, 忧惧, 拘捕
例句：It reflects real anger and apprehension about the future.
这反映出对未来真正的愤怒和忧虑。

perception
音标：英 /pə'sepʃ(ə)n/  美 /pɚ'sɛpʃən/
n. 理解感知,感觉DPS公司出的数字影像压缩卡
短语：visual perception — 视觉感知；视知觉
短语：aesthetic perception — 美感，审美观念；审美知觉
短语：depth perception — [心]深度知觉
短语：sensory perception — n. 感官知觉
短语：sense perception — n. 感觉
短语：motion perception — 运动知觉
短语：spatial perception — 空间知觉
短语：pain perception — 痛知觉
短语：consumer perception — 消费者知觉
短语：extrasensory perception — 超感知觉
短语：perception and understanding — 感知与理解
短语：role perception — 角色知觉
例句：He is interested in how our perceptions of death affect the way we live.
他对我们的死亡观如何影响我们的生活方式感兴趣。

minnow
音标：英 /'mɪnəʊ/  美 /'mɪno/
n. 鲤科小鱼
例句：The ghastly minnow is part of the largest family of freshwater fish—but so far its fangs are unique.
这种面目狰狞的小鱼是数目最庞大的淡水鱼家族的成员，不过其獠牙迄今无其它物种可出其右。

potency
音标：英 /'pəʊtnsɪ/  美 /'potnsi/
n. 力量
短语：high potency — 高效能
例句：The myth of male superiority was losing its potency.
男性优越的错误观念在逐渐失去影响力。

cogency
音标：英 /'kəʊdʒ(ə)nsɪ/  美 /'kəudʒənsi/
n. 力量, 中肯, 肯切
例句：But Hamas says, with some cogency, that it has been illegal for Mr Abbas to retain his post as the PA’s president since January this year, when his four-year term should have run out.
而哈马斯认为一月以后，鉴于阿巴斯的四年任期已到，若继续保持在巴权力机构的职位应被视为违法，这个看法还是比较中肯的。

assize
音标：英 /ə'saɪz/  美 /ə'saɪz/
n. 立法会议, 法令

legislature
音标：英 /'ledʒɪslətʃə/  美 /'lɛdʒɪsletʃɚ/
n. 立法机关, 立法机构
例句：The proposals before the legislature include the creation of two special courts to deal exclusively with violent crimes.
摆在议会面前的提案包括建立两个特殊法庭专门审理暴力犯罪案件。

foothold
音标：英 /'fʊthəʊld/  美 /'fʊt'hold/
n. 立足处
例句：Businesses are investing millions of dollars to gain a foothold in this new market.
商家们正投资数百万美元以求在新市场中赢得立足点。

altruism
音标：英 /'æltrʊɪz(ə)m/  美 /'æltruɪzəm/
n. 利他主义, 利他
例句：Many choose to work in developing countries out of altruism.
许多人无私地选择在发展中国家工作。

asphalt
音标：英 /'æsfælt; -əlt/  美 /'æsfɔlt/
n. 沥青
短语：asphalt pavement — 沥青混凝土路面
短语：asphalt concrete — 沥青混凝土
短语：modified asphalt — 改性沥青；改良沥青
短语：emulsified asphalt — 乳化沥青
短语：asphalt road — 沥青柏油路
短语：asphalt content — 沥青含量
短语：asphalt emulsion — 沥青乳液
短语：petroleum asphalt — [化]石油沥青
短语：asphalt felt — 油毡纸；沥青毡
短语：asphalt binder — 沥青结合料；沥青粘结剂，沥青胶泥
短语：asphalt paver — 沥青摊铺机；沥青铺洒机；地沥青
短语：asphalt plant — 制造沥青装置
短语：mastic asphalt — 沥青砂胶；石油沥青砂胶
短语：asphalt distributor — 沥青洒布车；沥青喷洒机
短语：asphalt cement — 沥青膏；地沥青胶泥；沥青水泥
例句：These comprise asphalt, tar and waxes.
其中包括沥青，焦油和蜡。

maroon
音标：英 /mə'ruːn/  美 /mə'run/
n. 栗色
例句：I wore a maroon velvet trouser suit that my daughter chose, and most of the village came to the reception.
那天，我穿了女儿为我挑选的栗色天鹅绒裤装，村庄里的大多数人都应邀参加了我的婚礼。
例句：On an impulse I grab a little maroon dress, pull Christiane from Frau Ballin's arms—she is still wearing only her undergarments—and quickly dress her in it.
慌乱中，我随手抓起一件栗色的连衣裙，给在巴林女士怀里的克丽丝汀换上，——可怜的克丽丝汀，她还穿着那件薄衬衣。

flail
音标：英 /fleɪl/  美 /flel/
n. 连枷
例句：We don't know of any other species that uses its body like a flail.
我们并不清楚其他任何鸟类种群是否将身体充当连枷。
例句：I wield the flail of the lashing hail, And whiten the green plains under.
我挥动冰雹的连枷，把绿色的原野捶打得有如银装素裹；
例句：Danilo galloped up in silence, holding a drawn dagger in his left hand, and thrashing the heaving sides of his chestnut horse with his riding whip, as though it were a flail.
丹尼洛默不作声地疾驰，左手中持着一柄拔出的短剑，像用连枷打谷似的用那条短柄长鞭抽打着栗色大马的收缩进去的两肋。

nexus
音标：英 /'neksəs/  美 /'nɛksəs/
n. 连结, 关系
例句：...the nexus between the dominant class and the State.
...统治阶级和国家间的关联。

hyphen
音标：英 /'haɪf(ə)n/  美 /'haɪfn/
n. 连字号
例句：When you described depression as a "disease" you might have spelled the word with a hyphen.
当你形容为“疾病”你可能有一个连字符的拼写单词抑郁症。
例句：Because she included the hyphen (-), nothing else is required; because 1=1 is always true, she will be able to log in successfully.
由于她包含了连字号（-），所以任何其他东西都不需要；由于 1=1 总是为真，所以她将能够成功登录。

vinculum
音标：英 /'vɪŋkjʊləm/  美 /'vɪŋkjʊləm/
n. 联结
例句：This product can deeply penetrate into skin, it is especially easy2 to be absorbed , and it can intensify skin vinculum tissue fabric;
深层渗透肌肤，特别容易吸收，强化肌肤结缔组织结构；
例句：The teacher in charge of class is a collective organizer and manager who plays the role of the vinculum with the teachers of all branches.
班主任是班集体的组织者和管理者，是联系各科任教师的纽带，是沟通学校、家长、社会的桥梁。

liaison
音标：英 /lɪ'eɪz(ə)n; -zɒn/  美 /lɪ'ezɑn/
n. 联络, (语音)连音
短语：liaison office — 联络处
短语：liaison officer — n. 联络官
短语：liaison committee — 联络委员会
例句：Liaison between police forces and the art world is vital to combat art crime.
警方和艺术界之间的联络对于打击艺术犯罪是至关重要的。

affiliation
音标：英 /əfɪlɪ'eɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /ə,fɪlɪ'eʃən/
n. 联系, 从属关系
短语：political affiliation — 政治背景；政治立场；政治面貌
例句：The kidnappers had no affiliation with any militant group.
这些绑架者与任何军事组织都没有紧密联系。

alchemy
音标：英 /'ælkɪmɪ/  美 /'ælkəmi/
n. 炼金术, 魔力
例句：Religion had an intimate association with alchemy during the Middle Ages.
在中世纪， 宗教和炼金术密切相联。
例句：How could the ultimate scientist have been seemingly hornswoggled by a totemic psuedoscience like alchemy, which in its commonest rendering is described as the desire to transform lead into gold?
一个终极科学家怎么会看上去像是被炼金术这种图腾伪科学所迷惑，而对这种伪学科最常见的描述是把铅变成黄金的欲望？
